name: Bangla NLP Multi-Task Dataset (Sentiment, Topic, Hate Speech)
description: A curated multi-task benchmark of 9,000 sentence-level Bengali text instances sourced from national news portals (Prothom Alo, Jugantor, Kaler Kantho, Bangladesh Pratidin), annotated across three key NLP tasks: sentiment analysis (3,000 samples), topic classification (4,000 samples), and hate speech detection (2,000 samples).
